title: PRAY THIS MORNING PRAYER BEFORE 9AM AND RECEIVE UNEXPECTED MIRACLES
text: Glory to Jesus. Father in heaven, we come before you this morning in the name of Jesus Christ. Before we even begin, someone is hearing this message and the Holy Ghost wants you to know that the siege against your life is over. The embargo on your blessings terminates today. You will share this message. You will send it because in Matthew 5:14-16, Jesus says you are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden. Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a bowl. Instead, they put it on its stand and it gives light to everyone in the house. God will use this word in your mouth to transform a generation. Someone's testimony will come out of your obedience to share this prophetic word. I want you to understand something from the beginning. There is a divine arrangement in prayer. There is a protocol in the heavenlies. When you pray in the morning before 9:00 a.m., you are not just praying, you are positioning yourself in the counsel of God. You are entering into a frequency that very few people understand. Listen carefully. In Psalm 88:2-13, it says, "But I cry to you for help, Lord. In the morning, my prayer comes before you." Do you see that? Morning prayer does not just enter heaven, it comes before God. It has a priority, it has an urgency, it comes first. But there is more than this. Many people pray and nothing happens. Many people fast and still walk in defeat. Why? Because prayer without revelation is like a soldier fighting without a weapon. Prayer without knowledge of the times and seasons is like a man striking in the darkness hoping to hit something. This is why we are gathered here this morning. The spirit of God has called us to pray with understanding, to pray with fire, to pray with authority that shakes the very foundations of darkness. Let me read to you from Ephesians 6:18-20. Paul says this, "Pray in the Spirit on all occasions with all kinds of prayers and petitions. With this in mind, be alert and always keep on praying for all the Lord's people. And pray also for me that whenever I speak, words may be given to me so that I will fearlessly make known the mystery of the gospel." Do you understand what Paul is saying? He's not just talking about ordinary prayer. He's talking about a warfare dimension, a dimension where prayer becomes the vehicle through which heaven invades earth. Now, the morning is crucial. Why the morning? Because morning is when the day is still new. The atmosphere is fresh. The demonic forces that operated during the night have not fully consolidated their operations. The heavens are still open. The Father's attention is still fresh. When you pray between the hours of dawn and 9:00 a.m., you are praying in a window where the veil is thin, where divine response is swift, where miracles find easy passage. There are dimensions to this that most teachers will not teach you. In 1 Kings 18:36, Elijah offered a sacrifice at the time of the evening offering. But in 2 Kings 3:11, Elisha would pour water on the hands of Elijah. The key here is not just the action. The key is the timing. The key is the alignment. When you understand timing in the spirit, when you understand the calendar of heaven, then prayer becomes weaponized. Prayer becomes dangerous to the kingdom of darkness. But listen, I must tell you something else. Before 9:00 a.m. is not just a time. It is a covenant mark. Let me explain what I mean. In Genesis 22, Abraham was called to offer Isaac. But he rose up early in the morning and prepared his altar. He got the wood, he called his young men, he went to the place God had told him about. And the scripture says in Genesis 22:3, "Early the next morning Abraham got up and saddled his donkeys. He took with him two of his servants and his son Isaac." Why did Abraham have to go in the morning? Because morning is when covenant operates most powerfully. Morning is when the father is looking for those who will meet him in the place of absolute surrender. Morning is when he distributes favor to those who position themselves in his counsel. Now, I want to shift. I sense the Holy Ghost moving here. There is someone under the sound of my voice and the spirit of God is saying to you that you have been waiting for a shift. You have been waiting for a change. You have declared this for years. You have fasted, you have prayed, you have stood in faith and the Holy Ghost says this morning that waiting is over. That season of suspension is terminated. The Lord says to you, "Before the day breaks, I will position you. Before the sun rises fully, your testimony will shift." Let me pray something into the atmosphere. Father God, in the name of Jesus Christ, I bind [music] every spirit of delay. I bind every demonic assignment that has said not yet to these people. I command every cause of procrastination to be broken by the blood of Jesus. Every altar in the witchcraft realm that has been designed to frustrate your destiny, catch fire now. Angels of the most high God, arise. Take your positions around this company. Let not one dark word come to pass. Let not one witchcraft assignment accomplish its purpose. I speak to your body. I speak to your health. Every pain that has no name, vanish now. Every sickness that the doctors could not diagnose, I command you to be healed by the power in the name of Jesus. Every cancer cell that has been multiplying in darkness, stop your multiplication now. You have no permission to thrive. You have no authority over this blood bought life. By the power of the resurrection, you are healed. Now, listen carefully. I want to take you deeper. In Proverbs 8:34, it says, "Blessed are those who listen to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at my doorway." This is what morning prayer is. It is watching at the doors of heaven. It is standing at the threshold where divine decisions are made. It is positioning yourself where the Lord himself is making decrees about your life. But, here is the revelation that will shift everything for you. Morning prayer before 9:00 a.m. is not just about asking, it is about declaring. It is about making prophetic decrees in alignment with heaven's will. When you decree in the morning, you are cooperating with the decree that the Father himself is making about your life and your season. Listen to what Proverbs 5:23 says. Though the context is different, but the principle is powerful. For the lips of the adulterous woman drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil. Why do I mention this? Because words have power. When you speak in the morning, your words have a particular potency. Hebrews 11:3 tells us, "By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God's command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible." Words create reality. Decrees establish dominion. When you speak in the morning with faith, with authority, with revelation, you are literally creating the day that is coming. You are framing the reality that you will walk in. This is why it is crucial. This is why the enemy wants to keep you in bed. This is why there is a spirit of slumber that fights against morning prayers. I decree and declare today that every spirit of slumber is broken over your life. Every assignment to keep you sleeping, to keep you distracted, to keep you disconnected from your morning prayer, I command that spirit to be bound by the blood of Jesus. I loose the spirit of vigilance. I loose the spirit of alertness. I loose the spirit of urgency over your morning season. Now, let me speak to something more specific. There are people in this service who are facing what I call the 9:00 a.m. barrier. What do I mean? Between 9:00 a.m. and 12:00 noon, there is a particular vulnerability. The scriptures call this the hour of prayer. In Acts 3:1, Peter and John went to the temple at the time of prayer, the ninth hour. This was not arbitrary. This was deliberate. At 3:00 p.m., which is the ninth hour, divine response is heightened. But, here is the warfare dimension. The enemy knows this, too. The enemy positions his forces at specific times to intercept your blessings. The enemy has watchers stationed at certain hours to prevent divine blessing from finding you. This is why prayer before 9:00 a.m. is so critical. You are praying before the enemy has fully assembled his forces. You are praying in a window of divine advantage. Someone here, I feel it in my spirit, you have been losing money in the marketplace. You have been losing contracts. You have been losing opportunities. The Lord is saying to you this morning that the leak is sealed. The hemorrhage stops today. I declare by the power of the blood of Jesus that every opening through which your substance has been flowing out is welded shut. Every demonic thief that has been assigned to your financial gates is bound, paralyzed, and rendered powerless. I speak to your business. I speak to your career. I speak to your source of income. Angels of the most high God, open the heavens, release abundance, release promotion, release sudden breakthrough. Let what should have come to you 6 months ago come to you in the next 48 hours. Let divine compensation overtake you. But, let me teach you the practical side of this. This is not just a word to receive. This is a word to act on. In James 2:26, it says, "As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead." So, here is what I am instructing you to do. Tomorrow morning, and I mean this with absolute conviction, you must wake up before 9:00 a.m. You must rise up while the dawn is still breaking. You must position yourself in a place of prayer. And in that place, you must do three things. First, you must engage in deep repentance, not surface repentance, but genuine turning from any area where you have walked in disobedience. In 1 John 1:9, the apostle says, "If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness." When you confess in the morning, you are cleansed for the day ahead. You are positioning yourself with a clean slate before heaven. Second, you must make specific decrees about what you want to see in your life. Do not pray vague prayers. Do not say, "God bless me." Be specific. Say, "God, I declare favor in my marriage today. I declare breakthrough in my health today. I declare provision for my children today. I declare wisdom for my decisions today." >> [music] >> Specificity in prayer creates specificity in results. Third, you must intercede for others. This is crucial. In Exodus 32:10, God was ready to judge the Israelites, but Moses stood in the gap. Listen to what happened. But Moses sought the favor of the Lord his God. Lord, he said, why should your anger burn against your people whom you brought out of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand? One man's intercession changed the trajectory of a nation. When you intercede in the morning, you are changing atmospheres. You are changing destinies. You are becoming a pipeline through which heaven's mercy flows to the earth. Now, I want to shift into something more prophetic. The Holy Ghost is moving on me right now. There is a woman I do not know your name, but the Lord knows you. You have been praying for a child. You have been believing God for a womb that would bring forth year after year. You have carried this prayer. Month after month, you have cried out. And the Holy Ghost says to you this morning, your womb is opening. I hear the sound of angels singing over your body. I see a child in your arms. I see you holding testimony. Before the year ends, you will testify. You will weep tears of joy because what you believe God for is now manifesting your body. And someone else, a man, you have been battling addiction. You have been struggling with a pattern. You have prayed. You have tried. You have fallen. You have repented. And you wonder if God still sees you. If God still loves you. If you still have a future. The Holy Ghost says to you, you [music] do. Your chains break today. The power that held you is powerless before the cross. I declare liberty over you. I declare restoration over you. I declare a future that is brighter than your past ever was dark. Let me now engage in warfare prayer. Come with me. Let us travail together. Father God, we come before you this morning as a company of believers who refuse to live under the curse. We refuse to live in bondage. We refuse to accept what the enemy has spoken over our lives. We come with boldness before your throne of grace in the name of Jesus Christ. We come against every spirit of poverty. We come against every spirit that says you cannot prosper. We come against every generational cycle of lack. By the authority vested in us through the cross, we command [music] poverty to depart. We command lack to be replaced with abundance. We command divine wealth to flow into the lives of these people. But Father, it goes deeper than this. We come against witchcraft. We come against the power of the witch in every realm. To every witch, every sorcerer, every warlock, every practitioners of darkness that have spoken against these people, I command your words to return to your own bosom. I command the curse you have spoken to become a curse upon yourself. Let your own words devour you. Let your own spells backfire. Let your own incantations bring judgment upon your head. I speak to every evil altar, every demonic table set up against these people, every sacrifice made in darkness to bring harm, I command you to be consumed by fire. I command holy judgment to come upon every unholy sacrifice. The blood of Jesus speaks against every word spoken in witchcraft. The blood of Jesus nullifies every demonic covenant. The blood of Jesus breaks every chain forged in hell. Now Father, we come to the matter of our destiny. We come to the matter of our purpose. There are people in this service whose destiny has been hijacked, whose purpose has been delayed, whose assignment has been contested father in this morning hour we reclaim what the enemy has stolen we recover what was lost we establish what was meant to be established I decree and declare that every thief of destiny is bound every demon assigned to derail your purpose is bound every witchcraft spell sent to frustrate your calling is broken your destiny is not up for negotiation your purpose is locked in with the throne of God nothing can change what the father has ordained about your life but father we also speak to the matter of family in so many homes there is brokenness there is division there is strife husbands and wives are estranged parents and children are in conflict siblings at war father we come against the spirit that divides we come against the demon that creates enmity we come against every force assigned to break families apart I declare healing over families I declare restoration of love I declare reconciliation where there has been silence let communication be restored where there has been anger let forgiveness flow where there has been bitterness let sweetness return every family under the sound of my voice I release the blessing of the father over you but let me be specific someone's marriage is on the edge your spouse looks at you with eyes that are no longer tender your communication has become from cold the intimacy has been replaced with distance the Holy Ghost says to you this morning there is hope there is a way back I decree supernatural rekindling I decree divine intervention in your marriage I call the blessing of God to cover your union let your marriage become a testimony of God's restoration and there is a man here whose son has gone astray your boy is mixed up with the wrong crowd he's making decisions that are breaking your heart. You have prayed, you have wept, you have fasted. You wonder if you will ever come back. The Lord says to you, he will. I see him returning. I see him kneeling before you asking for forgiveness. I see restoration happening. Do not give up. The battle is not lost. Your son will turn around. Now, let me shift. I want to address the matter of health. In 3 John 1 to 2, John writes, "Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you even as your soul is getting along well. Your body is important to God. Your health is not an accident. Your healing is part of the covenant." I speak to every person dealing with chronic illness. I speak to every person who has been diagnosed with a disease that the world says is terminal. I speak to every person whose body has been attacked by sickness. Listen carefully. The power of resurrection lives within you. When you accepted Jesus, when you gave your life to Christ, you received the same power that raised Jesus from the dead. That power dwells in your body. I command sickness to leave. I command disease to depart. I command your body to align with health. I command immune cells to rise up and fight. I command inflammation to cease. I command organs to function according to their original design. By the power that is in the name of Jesus, you are healed. And let me speak to something else. There are people here carrying pain that has no medical explanation. You have been to doctor after doctor, they find nothing, but the pain persists. The Holy Ghost is revealing to me that much of this pain is spiritual. It is a manifestation of spiritual attack. It is the enemy's way of wearing you down, of distracting you, of keeping you focused on what is wrong instead of on what is possible. I break that assignment now. I command every pain sent by the enemy to cease. I command your nervous system to be restored to peace. I command your body to feel wholeness. I command restoration. But Father, let me also address another dimension. There are people in this service who are grieving. You have lost someone. The void is real. The ache is persistent. You wake up and momentarily forget. Then reality crashes in again. You wonder how you will move forward. Listen to me. Your loved one is safe. They are with Jesus. They are in a place where there is no more pain, no more suffering, no more tears. And the Lord is saying to you that he will sustain you. He will walk with you through this valley. You will grieve, yes, but you will not grieve without hope. Resurrection hope, eternal hope. I declare supernatural comfort over every grieving heart. I declare the peace of God that passes understanding. I declare that sorrow will be temporary, but joy will be eternal. Now, let me teach you something that is going to transform your prayer life. In Psalm 5:2-3, David says, "In the morning, Lord, you hear my voice. In the morning, I lay my request before you and wait expectantly." But the key is the word expectantly. David was not just praying passively. He was praying with expectation. He was praying as if the answer was already coming. He was praying with the faith of someone who knows that God hears and that God responds. But here is what many believers are missing. Expectation without knowledge is just wishful thinking. You must know who you are. You must know what belongs to you. You must know the promises that are written over your life. In Romans 4:17, it says, "As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations." He is our father in the sight of God in whom he believed, the God who gives life to the dead and calls into being things that were not. Do you see what Abraham did? He believed and he became He believed in God who calls things that are not into existence. This is the God we serve. When you pray in the morning, you are speaking things into existence. You are calling forth what is not yet visible. You are releasing faith into the atmosphere. Let me give you examples. When you declare, "I am healed," you are calling your body into healing before it is fully manifest. When you declare, "I am blessed," you are calling blessings into your life before they visibly arrive. When you declare, "My children walk with God," you are speaking [music] destiny into their lives before they fully embrace it. This is powerful. This is dangerous to the kingdom of darkness. This is why the enemy tries so hard to keep you from morning prayer because in the morning, you have power. You have authority. You have the fresh anointing of heaven available to you. Someone here is facing a particular battle right now. You are caught in a cycle of fear. You wake up anxious. You go through your day afraid. You go to bed stressed. You wake up and the cycle repeats. The Holy Ghost is saying to you that you are not given a spirit of fear. Second Timothy 1:7 says it clearly, "For the spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love, and a sound mind." The spirit of fear is not from God. It is a demonic spirit and I am binding that spirit right now. I command the spirit of fear to lose its grip on your mind. I command your thoughts to be brought into captivity to the obedience of Christ. I declare peace, I declare confidence, I declare that you are not alone. The Lord is with you. His angels are with you. You will walk through this season with boldness and faith. Now, let me address something that is very specific. There are people whose breakthrough is waiting for a specific prayer that you have not yet prayed. Your miracle is tied to a decree that you have not yet made. Your deliverance is waiting for a command that you have not yet spoken. The Holy Ghost is saying to you, speak it now. Do not wait. Do not hesitate. In Mark 11:22-24, Jesus teaches about the power of words. He says, "Have faith in God. Truly I tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, 'Go, throw yourself into the sea,' and believes that what they say will happen, it will be done for them. Therefore, I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours." Jesus is telling you to speak to your mountain. What is your mountain? Is it debt? Is it disease? Is it depression? Is it delay? Whatever your mountain is, speak to it. Command it to move. Do not negotiate with it. Do not ask it to move. Command it. Listen carefully. There is authority in your words when you are aligned with heaven. There is [music] power in your decree when you are standing in faith. When you speak in the morning with the anointing, things shift. Things move. Things change. I am going to pray now, and I want you to pray with me. Not just with your lips. Pray with your whole being. Engage your faith. Speak from your belly. Let the prayer be violent. Let it be fierce. Let it be unstoppable. Almighty God, ancient of days, God who was and is and is to come. We honor you. We glorify you. We magnify your holy name. You alone are worthy, you alone are good, you alone hold the universe in your hands. We come to you this morning with gratitude. You have kept us through another night, you have sustained us, you have protected us. While we were sleeping, you were watching. While we were unaware, you were working. Your mercies are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness. And now, Father, we come with our petitions. We come with our declarations. We come with our decrees. Hear us from heaven. Hear the cry of your people. Hear the groan of your children. We're not asking you to do something you have not already promised. We're asking you to fulfill what you have said. Father, we declare freedom from every bondage. We declare healing from every sickness. We declare restoration in every broken place. We declare provision in every place of lack. We declare wisdom in every place of confusion. We declare strength in every place of weakness. Every generational curse, I break you by the power of the blood of Jesus. Every demonic assignment, I command you to depart. Every witchcraft spell, I nullify you. Every evil altar, I declare you consumed by fire. Every stolen blessing, I reclaim you. Every aborted destiny, I restore you. Angels of the most high God, we invite you. Come and surround these people. Come and protect us. Come and work on our behalf. Come and position us for miracles. Come and establish what the Father has ordained. Father, we speak to the hearts of people here. Some are broken, some are confused, some are desperate, but I declare that their breakthrough is coming. I declare that their season of waiting is over. I declare that what has been suspended will be released. I declare that what has been delayed will be accelerated. And Father, we declare that this morning, this time before 9:00 a.m., this sacred window, this holy hour, let it be marked in heaven as the moment that changed everything. Let the decree spoken here echo through the heavens. Let the prayers made here be answered swiftly. Let the petitions of these people be honored. Let the sick be healed. Let the bound be freed. Let the broken be mended. Let the lost be found. Let the dead be revived. Let the discouraged be strengthened. Let the fearful be emboldened. We declare it in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. We declare it by the power of the blood of Jesus. We declare it with the authority of believers who have been made righteous through Christ. We declare it with the boldness that comes from knowing we are seated in heavenly places. Let it be so. Let it be done. Let it come to pass. Now, let me speak something that is very specific that the Holy Ghost is putting in my spirit. I see a person you have been waiting for a job. You have sent out applications. You have been to interviews. You have been told no repeatedly. You wonder if anyone will ever say yes. The Lord is saying to you, yes is coming, but not just yes, exceptional yes. The position that opens for you will be better than you imagined. The salary will exceed what you asked for. The work will be fulfilling. I decree sudden employment. I decree that before this month ends, you will have a job offer. And there is someone else, you are a business owner or you want to be. You have invested. You have worked, but the results have not come. You wonder if you made a mistake, if you should give up. The Holy Ghost says, do not quit. You are on the edge of breakthrough. I decree that your business is about to boom. I decree that clients are coming. I decree that your name will become known. I decree that you will not only survive, you will thrive. And let me speak to you if you are a parent. You are raising children in a generation that is so difficult. You try to instill godly values. You try to teach them truth. But the world is pulling hard in the other direction. You wonder if your investments in their spiritual lives will matter. Listen to me, they will. In Proverbs 22:6, Solomon says, "Start children off on the way they should go. Even when they are old, they will not depart from it." Your prayers are working. Your teachings are taking root. Even if you cannot see it now, transformation is happening. I declare that your children will walk in the ways of God. I declare that they will become mighty men and women of faith. I declare that they will see the hand of God move in their lives, and they will give their lives to Jesus. Now, I want to address something that is deeper. There are people here who feel disqualified. You have made mistakes. You have sinned. You have done things that make you feel like you do not deserve God's blessing. You feel like you are forever marked by your past. The Holy Ghost is saying to you, "You are not." Your past does not define your future. Your mistakes do not determine your destiny. In Isaiah 43:18-19, the Lord says, "Forget the former things. Do not dwell on the past. See, I am doing a new thing. Now it springs up. Do you not perceive it? A new thing." That is what God wants to do in your life. Not a continuation of the old, a completely new chapter, a fresh start, a clean slate. When you come to Jesus, when you repent, when you turn from your sin, he throws it all away, all of it. He forgives. He forgets. He removes it as far as the east is from the west. I declare newness over your life. I declare that today is the day your new chapter begins. I declare that the old is gone and the new is here. Let me pray something very specific now. Father, I come against the spirit of self-condemnation. I come against the demon that keeps reminding people of their failures. I come against the force that says you are not worthy. I command that spirit to be bound and cast out. I declare that the accuser of the brethren has no authority over these people anymore. You are forgiven. You are clean. You are worthy. You are accepted. You are loved. The cross made you righteous. The resurrection gave you power. You have everything you need to walk in victory. Now, there is one more thing I must speak before we close this word. There is a strategic instruction the Holy Ghost is giving for those who will receive it. Starting tomorrow for the next 7 days, commit to early morning prayer before 9:00 a.m. every single day. Not because you feel like it, not because you have energy, but because you have faith. Because you have decided that your breakthrough is worth the sacrifice of sleep. In those 7 days, make specific decrees, specific petitions, specific prayers. Do not pray the same prayer every day. Let the Holy Ghost lead you. Let him show you what to pray. Some days you will pray for healing, some days for provision, some days for family, some days for your work, some days for the nations, but every prayer will be specific. Every prayer will be violent. Every prayer will be fierce. And I declare that by the end of that 7-day period, you will see shifts, you will see movements, you will see miracles. Not all at once, but enough to convince you that heaven is listening. Enough to strengthen your faith. Enough to make you a believer in the power of morning prayer. There is a woman who will read these words and she will weep. The Holy Ghost is saying to her that someone in her family who is far from God will come home. A prodigal will return. Someone will repent. Someone will give their life to Jesus and it will happen because you prayed. Your prayers will change a generation. There is a man who will receive this and the Lord is saying that your legacy will not be money. Your legacy will not be buildings. Your legacy will be your children walking with God and your children's children walking with God. I decree spiritual legacy. I decree that generations will rise up and call you blessed. Let me pray one more prayer and then we'll close this. Father, we stand before you in this early morning hour and we declare that the siege is over. Every assignment against these people terminated. Every curse broken. Every spell rendered powerless. Every demonic gate closed. Every witchcraft operation shut down. We declare favor. We declare abundance. We declare health. We declare strength. We declare courage. We declare wisdom. We declare peace. We declare joy. We declare that this company walking out of here today is walking into an unprecedented season of blessing. I speak to the angels. Come and go before these people. Clear the way. Open the gates. Prepare the path. Position them for miracles. Arrange divine appointments. Connect them with destiny helpers. Let the impossible become possible. I speak to the heavens. Open up. Release blessing. Release provision. Release healing. Release favor. Let it fall like rain upon these people. And now we declare the destiny of these people is preserved. The purpose of these people is protected. The blessing of these people is guaranteed. We have prayed. We have decreed. We have made our petitions known to the Father. And we are confident. We are assured. We are certain that what we have asked for in faith will come to pass. Before the day breaks, miracles will find you. Before the sun sets, shifts will occur. Before this week ends, testimonies will come. Before this month concludes, your life will be different. This is the promise. This is the declaration. This is the word from the throne of God. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen. Amen. Amen.
